en: A colorized historic postcard view of Cairo's Citadel complex. In the foreground are stone fortification towers, people walking, horse-drawn carriages, and soldiers or guards in red uniforms. In the background, a large mosque with a central dome and two tall minarets dominates the skyline, likely the Mosque of Muhammad Ali within the Cairo Citadel. The style is early 20th‑century chromolithograph.
